name: acm-agent-cost-monitor
description: Desktop monitor for costs and token usage across AI coding agents.
author: Thomas Blion

scripts.electron:build: npm run electron:build:main && npm run electron:build:preload
scripts.electron:build:desktop: npm run build && npm run electron:build:renderer && npm run electron:typecheck && npm run electron:build
scripts.electron:start: dotnet build src-dotnet/OpencodeCostsViewer.Backend.csproj -c Release && npm run electron:build:desktop && electron .
scripts.electron:dev: dotnet build src-dotnet/OpencodeCostsViewer.Backend.csproj -c Release && concurrently -k "npm:dev" "vite build --config electron/vite.config.electron.ts --watch" "vite build --config electron/vite.config.preload.ts --watch" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:1420 dist-electron/main.js dist-electron/preload.cjs && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1420 electron ."
scripts.desktop:package: npm run electron:build:desktop && npm run desktop:publish-backend && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --publish never
scripts.test:e2e:electron: dotnet build src-dotnet/OpencodeCostsViewer.Backend.csproj -c Release && npm run electron:build:desktop && cross-env E2E_ELECTRON=true node e2e/run-playwright.mjs
